modern: He who does wrong does wrong against himself. He who acts unjustly acts unjustly to himself, because he makes himself bad.

explained.summary: When you do wrong, the person you damage most is yourself. Others may lose something external, but you lose something worse: you make yourself into a worse person. For a Stoic, your character is the only thing that’s truly yours to ruin.
